spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (स्फेटते) r. 6th cl. (स्फुटति)
To blow, to blossom, to open as a bud or flower.
r. 10th cl. (स्फोटयति or with आङ् prefixed आस्फोटयति) also (इर) स्फुटिर r. 1st cl. (स्फोटति) and (इ) स्फुटि r. 1st cl. (स्फुण्टति)
1 To divide, to break, to tear, to pierce.
2 To hurt or kill.
स्फुटि r. 10th cl. (स्फुण्टयति)
To laugh at or with, to jest, to joke.

mfn. (-टः-टा-टं)
1 Blown, opened, expanded, (as a flower.)
2 Apparent, manifest, evident.
3 Known, understood.
4 Plain, distinct.
5 Spread, diffused.
6

White.
7

Burst, broken.
8 Rent, torn.
9 (In astronomy,) True or apparent, as स्फुटसूर्य्यगतिः true or apparent motion of the sun.
f. (-टा)
The expanded hood of a snake.
E.
स्फुट to blow, as a flower, &c. aff. क.

r. 10th cl. (स्फुट्टयति)
To disrespect.

mfn. (-टन्-टन्ती-टती-टत्)
1 Bursting, blowing.
2 Becoming manifest or clear.
3 Evolving.
E.
स्फुट to blow, शतृ aff.

f. (-ता)
1 Manifestation, evidence.
2 Blossoming.
E.
स्फुट, and तल् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Tearing, rending.
2 Opening, expanding.
E.
स्फुट to blow, ल्युट् aff., and the vowel unchanged; also स्फोटन.

n. (-लं)
(In geometry,) Distinct or precise area.
E.
ष्फुट, and फल fruit.

f. (-ली)
Heart-pea.
E.
स्फुट burst, and वल्कल bark or rind.

mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं)
Intelligible, obvious, significant.
E.
स्फुट, and अर्थ sense.

f. (-टिः-टी)
1 Kibe, swelling of the feet.
2 A sort of melon, (Cucumis momordica, Rox.)
E.
स्फुट to open or break, and कि aff., with ङीष् optionally added.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Budded, blown.
2 Broken, burst.
E.
स्फुट to blow, aff. क्त.

r. 6th cl. (स्फुडति)
To clothe, to cover.
(इ) स्फुडि r. 1st and 10th cls. (स्फुण्डति-स्फुण्डयति)
To laugh at, to jest, to joke.

m. (-रः)
Crackling, burning.
E.
स्फुत् imitative sound, and कार making.

r. 6th cl. (स्फुरति)
1 To throb, to beat.
2 To move.
3 To swell.

m. (-रः)
1 A shield.
2 Throbbing, trembling.
3 Swelling.
E.
स्फुर to shake, &c., aff. क.

nf. (-णं-णा)
1 Trembling, throbbing, pulsation.
2 Quivering of the lips, throbbing of the eyes, &c.
3 Expansion of mind.
E.
स्फुर to shake, aff. ल्युट् or युच्, and the radical vowel unchanged.

mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्)
1 Quivering, trembling, shaking, throbbing.
2 Expanding, swelling.
3 Going, moving.
4 Going tremulously.
5 Darting, starting.
E.
स्फुर to swell, &c., aff. शतृ.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Shaken, agitated.
2 Trembling, heaving, throbbing, palpitating.
3 Swelled, swollen.
n. (-तं)
1 Trembling or throbbing of the eye-lids.
E.
स्फुर to move or swell, aff. क्त.

(आ) स्फुर्च्छा r. 1st cl. (स्फुर्च्छति)
1 To spread, to expand.
2 To forget.

r. 1st cl. (स्फुर्ज्जति)
To thunder: more properly स्फूर्ज्ज.

(ओ आ) ओस्फूर्ज्जा r. 1st cl. (स्फूर्ज्जति)
To thunder.

m. (-र्ज्जः)
1 The sound of thunder.
2 INDRA'S thunderbolt.
E.
स्फूर्ज्ज to sound, as thunder, aff. अच्.

m. (-कः)
A sort of ebony, (Diospyros glutinosa.)
E.
स्फुर्ज्ज to make a noise like thunder, (on being burnt,) aff. वुन्; also स्फूर्ज्जक.

m. (-कः)
A sort of ebony, (Diospyros glutinosa.)
E.
स्फूर्ज्ज to sound like thunder, (in the fire, from its abounding with resin,) वुन् aff.

m. (-थुः)
A clap of thunder.
E.
स्फुर्ज्ज to sound as thunder, अथुच् aff.

m. (-थुः)
A clap of thunder, the sound of falling thunder, or that immediately following a stroke of lightning.
E.
स्फूर्ज्ज to sound as thunder, अथुच् aff.

r. 6th cl. (स्फुलति)
1 To throb.
2 To heap or crowd.
3 To be manifest or apparent.
4 To go or move.

n. (-लं)
A tent.
E.
स्फुल to expand, aff. क.

n. (-णं)
Throbbing, trembling.
E.
स्फुर to shake, aff. ल्युट्, and ल substituted for र.

mfn. subst. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं)
A spark of fire.
E.
स्फु for स्फुत् imitative sound, लिगि to go, aff. अच्.

f. (-नी)
One, of the seven tongues of AGNI or fire.
E.
स्फुलिङ्ग a spark, इनि and ङीप् affs.

n. (-नं)
Thundering.
E.
स्फूर्ज्ज, and ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Thundering.
E.
स्फूर्ज्ज, and मतुप् aff.

f. (-र्त्तिः)
Throbbing, palpitating, shaking.
E.
स्फुर to shake, aff. क्तिन्, and the vowel made long.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
1 Kind-hearted.
2 Tremulous, agitated.
E.
स्फूर्त्ति agitation, मतुप् aff., and the म retained.
